meta.name: performing-return-oriented-programming
meta.description: Methodology for building Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) chains to bypass NX/DEP by reusing existing code gadgets, covering gadget discovery, calling-convention argument setup, ret2libc, ret2syscall (execve), one_gadget, stack alignment, JOP, and stack pivoting across x86/x64/ARM64 during authorized engagements.

howto.what: Claude会指导你如何通过重用代码片段（gadgets）构建ROP链，以绕过NX/DEP保护，包括寻找gadget、设置参数、调用system或syscall等操作。
howto.when: 当你在授权的安全测试中，通过栈溢出等方式控制返回地址，但目标启用了NX/DEP无法执行注入的shellcode时触发。

say.text: 如何解决栈对齐问题？在system前插入一个ret gadget。
say.note: Claude会解释对齐原理并给出示例。

say.text: 我需要先泄漏libc地址，然后使用one_gadget。
say.note: Claude会提供两阶段利用的步骤。

howto.what_en: Guides you through building Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) chains to bypass NX/DEP by reusing code gadgets, covering gadget discovery, argument setup, calling system/syscall, alignment, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered during authorized exploitation when you control the saved return address (e.g., via stack overflow) but NX/DEP blocks injected shellcode, or when you need to call existing functions/syscalls.

say_en.text: Help me build a ret2libc chain for this x86-64 binary to call system('/bin/sh').
How do I fix stack alignment? Insert a bare ret gadget before system.
say_en.note: Claude explains alignment requirements and provides an example.

say_en.text: I need to leak libc first then use a one_gadget.
say_en.note: Claude outlines the two-stage exploit approach.
